trait_records_intent_check.name: trait_records_intent_check
trait_records_intent_check.value:
("trait_records"."responds_to_record_id" is null or "trait_records"."intent" is not null)
        and ("trait_records"."intent" is distinct from 'complement' or "trait_records"."responds_to_record_id" is not null)

trait_records_reference_check.name: trait_records_reference_check
trait_records_reference_check.value: "trait_records"."primary_reference_id" is not null or "trait_records"."secondary_reference_id" is not null

trait_records_origin_check.name: trait_records_origin_check
trait_records_origin_check.value:
("trait_records"."origin" = 'import' and "trait_records"."import_batch_id" is not null and "trait_records"."import_row_no" is not null and "trait_records"."created_by" is null and "trait_records"."supersedes_record_id" is null)
        or ("trait_records"."origin" = 'manual' and "trait_records"."created_by" is not null and "trait_records"."import_batch_id" is null and "trait_records"."import_row_no" is null
            and ("trait_records"."primary_reference_id" is not null or "trait_records"."supersedes_record_id" is not null))

trait_records_harmonised_check.name: trait_records_harmonised_check
trait_records_harmonised_check.value:
"trait_records"."harmonisation" <> 'harmonised' or "trait_records"."level_id" is not null
        or coalesce("trait_records"."numeric_value", "trait_records"."min_value", "trait_records"."max_value", "trait_records"."mean_value") is not null

trait_records_quantitative_check.name: trait_records_quantitative_check
trait_records_quantitative_check.value:
("trait_records"."min_value" is null or "trait_records"."max_value" is null or "trait_records"."min_value" <= "trait_records"."max_value")
        and ("trait_records"."sd_value" is null or "trait_records"."sd_value" >= 0) and ("trait_records"."n" is null or "trait_records"."n" >= 1)

bibliographic_references_book_check.name: bibliographic_references_book_check
bibliographic_references_book_check.value: ("bibliographic_references"."kind" = 'book') = ("bibliographic_references"."isbn" is not null) and ("bibliographic_references"."kind" <> 'book' or "bibliographic_references"."full_citation" is not null)
